findings.finding_text: L1's staged manifest cannot pass the dispatch budget gate: requiredBudgetMs = 3 phases x (retries+1) x (PARSE_FIX_ATTEMPTS+1) x maxDurationMs + 3 x ROUTING_MARGIN_MS = 741,000 ms > runBudgetMs 600,000, and no --timeout-ms is passed so the 600,000 default caller ceiling refuses it too — dispatch exits 2 manifest-rejected pre-spend on every run.
findings.label: BLOCKER
findings.rationale: Constants verified (types.ts PARSE_FIX_ATTEMPTS=2, ROUTING_MARGIN_MS=5_000); fix = runBudgetMs 900_000 + explicit --timeout-ms 960_000 mirroring tier2-rig-swarm-mixed's dual-role shape.

findings.finding_text: The staged-vs-committed roster byte-identity assert compares the staged copy to the same working-tree file it was copied from (tautology); the in-box roster is the ctx.sha copy and git cat-file -e checks existence only — worktree-vs-sha drift unguarded.
findings.label: HIGH
findings.rationale: Compare staged sha256 against git cat-file blob ctx.sha:<fixture> content.

findings.finding_text: The trace worker_output seam asserts includes(round.marker) but the marker is verbatim in the task prompt — a zero-result recall can pass; proves content availability, not tool invocation.
findings.label: HIGH
findings.rationale: Assert a substring unique to the kg-recall client's data framing (\"documentId\":\"m23-prime- JSON shape) that the brief's [cite:] rendering never produces.

findings.finding_text: The re-harvest divergent stderr assert is vacuous: that child runs NODE_ENV=test without QDS_LOG_VERBOSE so the fleet CLI skips the stderr sink — needs the same env the teardown verb uses.
findings.label: MED
findings.rationale: Add QDS_LOG_VERBOSE:1 to the re-harvest runFleet env.

findings.finding_text: DoD's roster-check preflight gate (bun scripts/roster-check.ts green on the new roster before fire) is not wired into the round.
findings.label: MED
findings.rationale: Run it pre-dispatch on the STAGED roster; exit 1 (slug rejected) = refuse; exit 2 (unevaluable host) = record warning and proceed (F097 letter kept where evaluable).

findings.finding_text: If L1's listedKeyHashes throws (pre-dispatch), hashesBefore stays empty and L3's finally keyLeakProblems flags every account key as leaked with revoke-by-hand noise — a false storm on an already-failing path.
findings.label: MED
findings.rationale: Skip keyLeakProblems when hashesBefore is empty; record a baseline-unavailable problem instead.

findings.finding_text: ttl clock-skew evidence (ttlExpiresAtMs/ttlFiredAtMs) is dropped from L3's battery evidence mapping — only the CLI path carries it.
findings.label: LOW
findings.rationale: Map the two fields into the battery evidence outcomes.

findings.finding_text: L1/L2 rethrow the body failure before their evidenceProblems check, so a failing body masks evidence-write refusals.
findings.label: LOW
findings.rationale: Rethrow a composite error appending evidence problems.

findings.finding_text: Unparseable [kg-recall] lines are counted but invisible in evidence and never flagged.
findings.label: LOW

findings.finding_text: The roster grants the credential-carrying fixer src/tests writes while the round's task forbids modification — least privilege says writes: [] for this round.
findings.label: LOW
findings.rationale: Set fixer writes: [] with a comment.

findings.finding_text: The cat-file guard conflates a locally-absent SHA with a fixture-absent-at-SHA — the operator cannot tell a fetch problem from a commit problem.
findings.label: LOW
findings.rationale: Check SHA existence first, then fixture-at-SHA, with distinct messages.

findings.finding_text: Auditor F7 claimed the teardown QDS_LOG_VERBOSE unmute is unnecessary (fleet CLI stderr sink unconditional).
findings.label: LOW
findings.rationale: Verified wrong: run() skips the hardened fd-2 sink under NODE_ENV=test without QDS_LOG_VERBOSE (fleet.ts:2421-2426) — the env is load-bearing for the AC4 greps.
